limitations: Source: China Shenhua Energy Company Limited, August and September 2026 major operational data announcements, independently published originals on HKEXnews. Two original two-page PDFs were downloaded, text-extracted and visually inspected. This curation retains 13 operating indicators per month, six original numerical columns per indicator, not the full announcements.

The columns distinguish current month, current YTD, restated same month last year, restated prior-year YTD and two publisher YoY rates. Parenthesized original negative percentages are normalized to a minus sign; the two original YoY cells remain alongside. The 156 count denotes distinct source cells and does not count repeated format fields twice.

Chinese indicator names are concise curation of the English original; units are unchanged in scale. Physical sales, production, transport volume, tonne-distance turnover and power dispatched are different metrics and are not summed or reclassified as price data.

The issuer states business volumes of newly consolidated assets are included from April 2026 and prior-year corresponding figures have been retrospectively adjusted. The restated prior-year values are not original 2025 vintages; do not connect an unrevised older scope without reconciliation.

These are internal operating statistics that may differ from periodic reports and vary with weather, maintenance, seasonality and safety inspections. Published year-on-year rates can differ from rounded-level calculations. No YTD subtraction, own-production attribution to all sales, net profit inference or issuer procurement relationship is created.

Each row retains its original publication date and PDF URL. Source published_at is the later HKEX publication on 14 October; do not replace it with the 15 October A-share newspaper publication date or assert independently archived historical availability.

The separate SSE URL returned a compressed JavaScript security page and was not used as a PDF or bypassed. HKEXnews public issuer documents were independently located and read. Initial local downloads encountered the filesystem execution network restriction; the same public downloads then succeeded through the standard approved network execution mechanism.

Necessary factual excerpt with source attribution, not a public raw-document mirror or inference of unrestricted exchange market-data rights. The existing read-source consumer preserves these reported facts without constructing commodity market-price conventions.
